categories_thin: Independent retail: North Brunswick retail is dominated by big-box centres (North Brunswick Plaza, Renaissance Square, Shoppes at North Brunswick). Most small-shop entries are directory-only and unverified - expect both misses and closed shops.

Manufacturing and wholesale: D&B reportedly counts 41 manufacturers in town, but only two could be verified by name (Parkway-Kew, Atlantic Precision); the Jersey Ave / Excelsior Ave industrial parks are almost undocumented in public directories.
Event venues: only three found (The Ashi, Brunswick Social Club, Eagle's Landing); larger halls may sit just outside town lines.
Music and art schools: mostly single-instructor studios with no street address published.
Repair services: very thin - vacuum/sewing and phone repair only; most electronics and appliance repair is routed to Route 18 in East Brunswick.
caveats: Franchise and brand locations were excluded per the brief: Goddard School, Kiddie Academy, Lightbridge Academy, The Learning Experience, Kids 'R' Kids, Kumon, Mathnasium, Huntington Learning Center, Eye Level, Home Depot, Walmart, Target, Staples, Floor & Decor, Best Tile, Floor Coverings International, Holiday Inn Express, Ramada, and national furniture chains (Raymour & Flanigan, Ashley, Macy's furniture gallery, Mattress Firm). Barnes & Noble, AutoZone and similar chains that appeared in town directories were also left out.
Loc8NearMe and similar pages render business names only in link slugs, so a few directory-only names may differ slightly from the legal trade name.
The Shoppes at North Brunswick directory page returned almost no usable text, so that retail centre's tenants are likely under-represented.
Hotels: only Farrington Inn is clearly independent; the Route 1 properties are chain-flagged.
Phones were recorded only where a source displayed them; many small shops publish no phone online, so 'Unknown' appears frequently.
data_gaps: Overpass API was rate-limited or gateway-timed-out on several attempts, so OSM coverage is partial (shop nodes/ways only; one result slice unread).

The browser was shared with other sessions - navigations and page reads landed on other tabs' content and one search engine served a CAPTCHA, so Google Maps and Bing Maps result lists could not be harvested. Those would be the fastest way to add missing small shops.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, localitybiz, firmania, find-open and the Middlesex County chamber directory all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so only their search-snippet content is reflected.
NJ Business Directory shows 87 North Brunswick listings but its pagination returned identical page 1 content; roughly 60 of those listings were not reviewed.

D&B's North Brunswick manufacturing list (41 firms) could not be opened; names seen only in a search summary (General Foundries, Chemspeed Technologies, John Maltese Iron Works) were not added because they could not be independently verified.
North Brunswick Township's own website was not reached for a licensed-business or economic-development list; worth a direct check by the next researcher.
